surprise_state.notes: Allowed when no decision-material event/expectation shock is active.

regime_state.notes: Directional Fundamental analysis must state regime, unavailable, or undetermined.

causal_graph.notes: Directional Fundamental analysis must state a graph, unavailable, or undetermined.

consumption_state.notes: BUY/SELL permission must characterize consumption or disclose unavailable/undetermined.

driver_transition.notes: Allowed for first observation or no prior driver state.

global_reconciliation.notes: Allowed for single-market runs with no cross-market reconciliation input.
